description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Early-career Full Stack Engineer with a focus on AI Engineering to help build next-generation intelligent applications powered by large language models (LLMs). This role sits at the intersection of application development, data engineering, and applied AI—developing scalable systems that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM evaluation frameworks, and agent-based architectures.
  
  
You will work closely with platform, data, and product teams to build AI-powered experiences using Azure, Databricks, Postgres, and modern AI/agent frameworks.
  
  
**Major Duties**
AI & Application Development
  
  

* Build end-to-end AI-powered applications (UI + backend services + model orchestration)
* Design and implement RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval and grounding
* Develop and deploy LLM-based workflows and agents (multi-step reasoning, tool use, orchestration)
* Integrate models via APIs and hosted platforms (Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, etc.)

LLM Evaluation & Quality
  
  

* Develop LLM evaluation frameworks (accuracy, hallucination detection, relevance, safety)
* Implement automated testing and benchmarking for prompt chains and agents
* Define and monitor LLM performance metrics (precision, recall, grounding fidelity)
* Support experimentation (prompt engineering, model comparisons, fine-tuning readiness)

Data & Backend Engineering
  
  

* Build and optimize data pipelines leveraging Databricks (Spark, Delta)
* Design and query structured and semi-structured datasets using Postgres
* Enable efficient retrieval layers (vector search, embeddings, indexing strategies)
* Support data modeling for AI use cases (knowledge bases, feature stores)

Platform & Agent Development
  
  

* Develop AI agents within Databricks and Azure ecosystems
* Integrate orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
* Build reusable services/APIs for agent capabilities (search, summarization, reasoning)

Full Stack Development
  
  

* Contribute to lightweight front-end interfaces for AI applications (React or similar)
* Build backend APIs/services (Python-based frameworks)
* Ensure production readiness (logging, monitoring, scalability, security)

**Experience & Qualification**

* 4+ years of relevant experience in AI engineering, building AI applications, LLM, Python.
* B.E/B.Tech or above degree requried.

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
**Who is DexCare?**

  

DexCare optimizes time in healthcare, streamlining patient access, reducing waits, and enhancing overall experiences. Guided by our mission – Nobody waits for care – DexCare addresses tech gaps by aligning supply and demand to modernize healthcare infrastructures for an inclusive ecosystem. We are equally committed to our DEIB mission: Creating an inclusive workplace where diversity drives innovation, equity ensures fairness, and belonging strengthens collaboration, enabling everyone to thrive. 

  

 

  

**What is DexCare?**

  

DexCare, a digital care orchestration platform, streamlines care delivery logistics. It empowers healthcare systems to predict constraints and precisely schedule services, optimizecapacity, and cuts operational costs. Currently serving 57 million patients, including Kaiser Permanente and Providence, DexCare ushers in a new era of digital-care access, ensuring health systems can efficiently track and deliver every hour of capacity for consumer ease.

  
  

For more information, visit
www.dexcare.com
or follow us on
LinkedIn
. 

**About the Role**

  

DexCare is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build the AI systems behind our products. Your primary focus will be Optimize AI, which ingests, structures, and governs complex healthcare scheduling rules and institutional knowledge into a single, verified source of truth. The core problem is turning large volumes of messy, inconsistent, and constantly changing operational knowledge into structured knowledge that people and AI agents can rely on to make decisions.

  
  

This is a hands-on, mid-level role. You will build, ship, and own production ML and LLM systems, working closely with product, engineering, and data teams. Our AI products share a common foundation, so you will also work across them, including Mila, our patient-facing agents, as priorities shift. You will join a well-established team early in the build-out of DexCare’s AI capabilities, with large health systems already using our products. If you enjoy taking ML systems from prototype to production and making them accurate, reliable, and fast, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**
  

  
* Build systems that ingest unstructured and inconsistent source material, such as policies, protocols, rules, and spreadsheets, and turn it into structured, versioned, and verified knowledge.
  
* Build extraction, normalization, and validation pipelines using LLMs and classical techniques; detect conflicts, gaps, and stale information, and route uncertain cases to human review.
  
* Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that give downstream systems and agents accurate, grounded, and traceable answers with low latency.
  
* Build, ship, and maintain components of the agentic systems that act on this knowledge, including orchestration, tool calling, and state management.
  
* Build evaluation for the systems you ship: ground-truth datasets, accuracy metrics, regression tests that run before every release, LLM-as-judge and human review, and monitoring of quality in production.
  
* Diagnose and improve accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost of ML systems in production.
  
* Build components that can be reused across DexCare’s AI products, and contribute to other products as priorities shift.
  
* Follow ML lifecycle best practices: versioning of models, prompts, datasets, and knowledge; deployment; monitoring; and retraining.
  
* Handle patient and customer data in line with HIPAA and DexCare’s privacy and security standards.
  
  

  
**What You’ll Bring**
  

  
* 7-9 years of experience in machine learning or software engineering, including building and running production ML systems.
  
* Experience building systems that extract, structure, and verify knowledge from unstructured sources, such as documents, policies, or operational data, with measurable accuracy.
  
* Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based agentic systems to production, including orchestration, tool calling, and handling failures with retries and fallbacks.
  
* Experience building retrieval systems and improving their accuracy and latency.
  
* Experience evaluating ML and LLM systems: building eval datasets, defining metrics, and using the results to decide what ships.
  
* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, code review, and API design.
  
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and at least one major cloud platform.
  
* Clear communication and the ability to work across product, engineering, and data teams, including across time zones.
  
* Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces where requirements and data evolve.
  
  

  
**Preferred**
  

  
* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Google ADK.
  
* Experience with Azure / AWS and their ML and AI services.
  
* Experience with knowledge graphs, rules engines, or other structured knowledge representations.
  
* Experience with predictive ML or optimization for problems such as forecasting, scheduling, ranking, or matching.
  
* Experience with guardrails, safety classifiers, or red-teaming for LLM applications.
  
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including handling PHI under HIPAA.
